title: Display labels and conventions for one CV language
description: Everything language-specific that a rendered CV or letter needs, so that templates carry zero language strings. One file per language: i18n/labels.<lang>.yaml, in the package or overriding it from a data root. A missing key fails validation instead of rendering blank.

language.description: Must match the file name labels.<language>.yaml

present.description: Shown as the end of an ongoing date range

date_format.description: How month-precision dates are displayed in this language

months.description: Month names, January first; used for the cover-letter date

language_names.description: ISO 639-1 code -> language name in this language

levels.description: Profile language level keys (e.g. native) -> display text; unknown keys pass through
